```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ============================================================
# HPAP Spleen scRNA-seq Pseudobulk DEG (DESeq2) + GSEA
# - Seurat v5 (layers) compatible
# - Pseudobulk per cell type: aggregate counts by sample (donor__group)
# - DESeq2: T1D vs ND
# - QC: cell composition + sample retention curves
# - Downstream: volcano, heatmap, Hallmark/C2 fgsea, GO gseGO
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(Matrix)
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)

  library(DESeq2)
  library(pheatmap)
  library(ggrepel)

  library(msigdbr)
  library(fgsea)

  library(clusterProfiler)
  library(enrichplot)
  library(org.Hs.eg.db)
  library(tibble)
})

set.seed(1234)

# -------------------------
# Config
# -------------------------
in_rds      <- "/Users/jyotirmoyroy/Desktop/Immunometabolism T1D Paper/SingleCellRNASeq/MAI_T1D/spleen_result.rds"
assay_name  <- "RNA"
count_layer <- "counts"   # Seurat v5 layer
out_dir     <- "results_pseudobulk"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Metadata columns in your Seurat object
donor_col  <- "donor"            # donor ID column (may contain underscores)
group_col  <- "group"            # will be created: ND/T1D/(Excluded)
sample_col <- "samples"          # will be created: donor__group (ND/T1D only)
cluster_col <- "seurat_clusters" # used for mapping to cell types
celltype_col <- "celltype"       # will be created

# Donor sets (edit as needed)
healthy_donors   <- c("HPAP008","HPAP129","HPAP019","HPAP029","HPAP024","HPAP117","HPAP112","HPAP045","HPAP038")
t1d_donors       <- c("HPAP071","HPAP041","HPAP135","HPAP123","HPAP087","HPAP028","HPAP102","HPAP020","HPAP023","HPAP084")
excluded_stage1  <- c("HPAP107")  # excluded explicitly

# Cluster -> cell type map (edit as needed)
# New major-type mapping for spleen clusters
cluster_map <- c(
  "0"  = "B",
  "1"  = "B",
  "2"  = "B",
  "3"  = "B",
  "4"  = "B",
  "5"  = "T",
  "6"  = "B",
  "7"  = "NK",
  "8"  = "T",
  "9"  = "B",
  "10" = "T",
  "11" = "Monocyte",
  "12" = "NK",
  "13" = "T",
  "14" = "T",
  "15" = "T",
  "16" = "B",
  "17" = "T",
  "18" = "T",
  "19" = "T",
  "20" = "B",
  "21" = "B",
  "22" = "NK/ILC",
  "23" = "Cycling",
  "24" = "Plasmablast",
  "25" = "T",
  "26" = "T",
  "27" = "NK",
  "28" = "T"
)

# DEG defaults
deg_target_celltype <- "Monocyte"  # must match cleaned labels (spaces removed)
deg_min_cells_per_sample <- 30
deg_min_reads_per_gene   <- 10
deg_min_prop_samples     <- 0.25
deg_lfc_thresh           <- 0.5
deg_padj_thresh          <- 0.05

# Heatmap
heatmap_top_n <- 30

# External list (optional overlap check)
#top100_path <- "/data/temp/Top100Genes_T1D_HumanOrthologs.csv"
#top100_symbol_col <- "human_symbol"
```

```{r sload_object}
# =========================
# 1) Load Seurat Object
# =========================
obj <- readRDS(in_rds)
obj
```

```{r prepare metadata}
# =========================
# 2) Prepare metadata: donor_norm, group, sample_id
# =========================
md <- as.data.frame(obj[[]])

stopifnot(donor_col %in% colnames(md))

# Normalize donor IDs: HPAP_107 -> HPAP107
md$donor_norm <- gsub("_", "", as.character(md[[donor_col]]))

# Assign group
md[[group_col]] <- NA_character_
md[[group_col]][md$donor_norm %in% healthy_donors]  <- "ND"
md[[group_col]][md$donor_norm %in% t1d_donors]      <- "T1D"
md[[group_col]][md$donor_norm %in% excluded_stage1] <- "Excluded_Stage1"

# sample_id = donor_norm__group for ND/T1D only; otherwise donor_norm
md[[sample_col]] <- md$donor_norm
keep_encode <- !is.na(md[[group_col]]) & md[[group_col]] %in% c("ND","T1D")
md[[sample_col]][keep_encode] <- paste0(md$donor_norm[keep_encode], "__", md[[group_col]][keep_encode])

# Write back
obj@meta.data <- md

# Keep ND/T1D only for downstream
# after obj@meta.data <- md
stopifnot(group_col %in% colnames(obj@meta.data))

keep_cells <- rownames(obj@meta.data)[ obj@meta.data[[group_col]] %in% c("ND","T1D") ]
obj <- subset(obj, cells = keep_cells)

cat("Group counts:\n")
print(table(obj@meta.data[[group_col]]))
cat("Unique samples (donor__group): ", length(unique(obj@meta.data[[sample_col]])), "\n")


# =========================
# 3) Choose Harmony cluster column (author's) and map to celltype
# =========================

# Prefer the author's Harmony clustering column if present
if ("cluster" %in% colnames(obj@meta.data)) {
  cluster_col_use <- "cluster"         # Harmony clusters saved by author
} else if ("seurat_clusters" %in% colnames(obj@meta.data)) {
  cluster_col_use <- "seurat_clusters" # fallback
} else {
  stop("No cluster column found: expected 'cluster' or 'seurat_clusters'.")
}

cat("Using cluster column for celltype mapping: ", cluster_col_use, "\n")

# Map cluster -> celltype (write into meta.data explicitly)
cl <- as.character(obj@meta.data[[cluster_col_use]])
ct <- unname(cluster_map[cl])

if (any(is.na(ct))) {
  bad <- sort(unique(cl[is.na(ct)]))
  stop("Unmapped clusters found in cluster_map: ", paste(bad, collapse = ", "))
}

obj@meta.data[[celltype_col]] <- gsub("\\s+", "", ct)
obj@meta.data[[celltype_col]] <- factor(obj@meta.data[[celltype_col]])

Idents(obj) <- obj@meta.data[[celltype_col]]

cat("Cell types (levels):\n")
print(levels(Idents(obj)))

# =========================
# 4) Plot using Harmony UMAP
# =========================
if (!("umap" %in% Reductions(obj))) stop("No reduction named 'umap' in this object.")

celltypes <- levels(factor(obj[[celltype_col]][,1]))
pal <- setNames(scales::hue_pal(l = 55, c = 120)(length(celltypes)), celltypes)

DimPlot(
  obj,
  reduction = "umap",
  group.by  = celltype_col,
  cols      = pal,
  pt.size   = 0.35,
  alpha     = 0.8,
  raster    = FALSE,
  label     = TRUE,
  repel     = TRUE,
  label.box = TRUE
) +
  NoAxes() +
  ggtitle("HPAP Spleen UMAP") +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  )
saveRDS(obj,"/Users/jyotirmoyroy/Desktop/Immunometabolism T1D Paper/SingleCellRNASeq/MAI_T1D/spleen_result_annotated.rds")
```
